content: Synapse The Undiscovered Country . STAND ALONE .  Judy is a brilliant research fellow, on the fast track for chance to partner in a new startup, the only thing standing in her way is the paper she is working on,  pushing the envelope Judy , working late one night is exposed to an experimental prion disease, at first she thinks nothing of it until things begin to happen and Judy realizes that somehow she has been altered. She isn’t the only one as Judy finds herself the target of a massive manhunt to gain the knowledge of her mind.  Prion Disease She is messing around with a prion disease that begins a chemical and DNA reaction in her body .  Like a disease it begins overtaking cells and changing them, at the same time it also begins to alter her mind, opening areas that no human has experienced before. Judy Black PostGrad  Research Fellow at a thinktank Short and bookish, a quiet girl who likes books more  then   people ,  she is brilliant at her job but not very good at interpersonal relationships. NOTES: These are notes on the book that I can add later as I think of things  Everyone wants the secret and they will kill to get it Its only him and his accidental research assistant who is exposed to the new disease She is now augmented and they two have to go on the run.  He is forced to also expose himself to the disease to survive and the two of them must stay ahead of every government on the planet or risk being captured and  directed .
